title: Circle Area Calculator MicroSim
description: Interactive visualization demonstrating the relationship between a circle's radius, area (πr²), and circumference (2πr) with real-time calculations and visual feedback. Students can adjust the radius slider to observe how area grows quadratically while circumference grows linearly.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: geometry
circles
area
circumference
pi
radius
quadratic relationships
mathematical formulas
interactive learning
learningObjectives: Calculate the area of a circle from its radius using A = πr²
Calculate the circumference of a circle from its radius using C = 2πr
Compare the quadratic growth of area with the linear growth of circumference as the radius slider increases
Predict how doubling the radius quadruples the area but only doubles the circumference
Explain the role of π as the constant that links a circle's radius to its circumference and area
